# Group Workflow

To keep the group work clear and efficient, one student first created the GitHub repository and set up the Quarto document structure. The main sections and subheadings were prepared in advance to guide the team on what content needed to be included and how the final report should be organized.

The individual Quarto documents were then distributed among the group members. Each student worked on their assigned section using a separate Git branch. Once a section was completed, it was reviewed by the group and then merged into `main`.

The master Quarto document combines all completed sections into the final report.

| Student | Quarto Document |
|---|---|
| Student 1 | `01_generate_known_signal.qmd` |
| Student 2 | `02_time_derivative.qmd` |
| Student 3 | `03_tangential_speed.qmd` and `04_interactive_plot.qmd` |
